title: Website Screenshot input
description: Take screenshots (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and optional PDFs of any number of web pages. Cookie banners and ads are hidden automatically.

urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Web pages to capture, one per line, e.g. https://apify.com. Addresses without http(s):// get https:// added. Duplicates are skipped. Objects like {"url": "https://..."} are accepted too when calling via API.

startUrlsDatasetId.title: …or dataset with URLs
startUrlsDatasetId.description: ID or name of an Apify dataset (e.g. the results of another Actor) to read URLs from. Combined with the list above. Useful for chaining: scrape a list of pages, then screenshot them.

urlField.title: URL field in dataset
urlField.description: Field of each dataset item that contains the URL. Nested fields use dots, e.g. "page.url". Ignored if no dataset is set.

device.title: Device
device.description: Screen size and device type. Desktop 1920×1080, Laptop 1366×768, Tablet 768×1024 (2x pixels, touch), Mobile 390×844 (3x pixels, touch, mobile browser). Choose Custom to set your own width and height.

width.title: Custom width (px)
width.description: Browser window width in CSS pixels. Only used when Device is "Custom size".

height.title: Custom height (px)
height.description: Browser window height in CSS pixels. Only used when Device is "Custom size".

scaleFactor.title: Pixel density (scale factor)
scaleFactor.description: Image pixels per CSS pixel. 1 = normal, 2 = retina-sharp (4× more pixels, bigger files). Leave empty to use the device default (desktop/laptop 1, tablet 2, mobile 3).

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: Capture the whole page from top to bottom instead of only the visible window.

format.title: Image format
format.description: PNG is lossless (best for text and QA). JPEG and WebP are much smaller (best for archives and AI). WebP images are at most 16,383 pixels tall.

quality.title: Quality (JPEG / WebP)
quality.description: Compression quality from 1 to 100 for JPEG and WebP. Ignored for PNG.

clipSelector.title: Capture only this element
clipSelector.description: CSS selector of a single element to capture instead of the page, e.g. "#pricing" or "main article". The first matching element is used.

maxHeight.title: Max. height for full page (px)
maxHeight.description: Full-page screenshots taller than this (in CSS pixels) are cut here, so endless-scroll pages do not produce giant images. 0 = no limit.

savePdf.title: Also save as PDF
savePdf.description: Also save each page as an A4 PDF (print version of the page, with backgrounds). Charged as a separate PDF export event.

hideCookieBanners.title: Hide cookie banners
hideCookieBanners.description: Hide cookie and consent pop-ups (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi, Quantcast, TrustArc, Usercentrics, CookieYes and similar, plus generic fixed cookie bars). Nothing is clicked or accepted.

blockAds.title: Block ads and trackers
blockAds.description: Block requests to common ad, tracking and analytics networks and hide empty ad slots. Pages usually also load faster.

hideSelectors.title: Hide these elements
hideSelectors.description: CSS selectors of elements to remove before capturing, e.g. chat widgets or sticky headers: "#intercom-container", ".newsletter-popup".

scrollToBottom.title: Scroll to load lazy images
scrollToBottom.description: For full-page and element screenshots: scroll through the page first so lazy-loaded images and sections appear, then go back to the top.

darkMode.title: Dark mode
darkMode.description: Tell the website the visitor prefers a dark color scheme. Only sites that support dark mode change.

waitUntil.title: Wait until
waitUntil.description: When the page counts as loaded. "Load" is best for most sites. "Network idle" waits until nothing loads for 0.5 s (good for single-page apps). If a page never reaches it, the screenshot is still taken at the timeout, with a warning.

delaySecs.title: Extra delay (seconds)
delaySecs.description: Wait this long after the page has loaded, e.g. for animations, sliders or charts to finish.

waitForSelector.title: Wait for element
waitForSelector.description: CSS selector that must be visible before the screenshot, e.g. ".product-grid". If it does not appear in time, the URL is reported as failed (and not charged).

timeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Maximum time for loading one page (per attempt).

retries.title: Retries per URL
retries.description: How many times to retry a URL after a network error, timeout or HTTP 429/5xx response. Each retry uses a new proxy IP when a proxy is enabled.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel pages
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages are captured at the same time. Higher is faster but needs more memory: about 1 page per 512 MB (e.g. 4 at 2 GB, 8 at 4 GB).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Use a proxy for sites that block data-center traffic or show country-specific content. Apify residential proxies help with strict anti-bot sites. No proxy by default.

userAgent.title: Custom user agent
userAgent.description: Override the browser's User-Agent header. Leave empty to use a normal Chrome user agent that matches the chosen device.

outputZip.title: Also create a ZIP with all files
outputZip.description: Bundle all screenshots (and PDFs) into one screenshots.zip in the key-value store. The download link is in the OUTPUT record.
